ablation: Force IC health to one so the stock turbulence overlay always acts; this tests whether abstention/health gating contributes rather than the raw risk score alone.
allocation_rule: Inverse blended realized-risk/ATR allocation with 25% name cap; stock overlay multiplies portfolio gross only and never changes coin ranks.
cash_rule: Unused capped allocation and all overlay de-risking remain cash.
contamination_notes: User-directed allocator hypothesis. No strategy return metrics were inspected before this preregistration. Public Quantiacs documentation and the repository's frozen historical family map were inspected for admissibility/novelty only. The local sandbox could not reach GitHub/Quantiacs, so no market measurement occurred before the freeze.
cost_hypothesis: Risk reduction should be persistent enough to survive contest costs because name rotation/re-risk is weekly; unscheduled changes are de-risk-only and require a >=15 percentage-point gross reduction.

admissibility_basis: Q25 official rules require Sponsor-provided data only.
Quantiacs documentation provides S&P 500 data through qnt.data and documents multi-dataset backtests using external sponsor datasets as indicators.
A Q25-specific hosted precheck is still required before submission because generic platform availability is not treated as final contest clearance.

decision_time_availability: Stock EOD state is carried forward to the crypto daily calendar. IC at date t correlates stock risk_on from t-1 fresh stock sessions with crypto return realized at t; no future-return series or negative shift is used.
expected_failure_modes: equity-to-crypto risk transmission is unstable or vanishes after 2022
IC health is too sparse/slow and abstains most of the time
raw turbulence helps but IC gating adds no value
immediate risk cuts create enough ATR-linked turnover to erase protection
stock-close/crypto-daily timestamp semantics make same-date use inadmissible in hosted evaluation
cross-dataset Q25 use is rejected despite both datasets being sponsor-provided
falsifier: Invert the stock turbulence direction while preserving the same IC-health, consensus and execution machinery; if the inverted overlay matches or beats the parent, the risk-direction story is falsified.
mechanism: Sponsor-provided S&P 500 systemic turbulence state with causal online IC-health abstention, applied only as a gross-exposure overlay to an automatic crypto cross-sectional parent.
novelty_note: Unlike C165's crypto-internal market-consensus timing, this experiment uses dynamic S&P 500 constituent state as the primitive and refuses to act unless a fully realized rolling IC remains positive and statistically supported across two horizons. Portfolio construction is intentionally an overlay, so this is not claimed as independent alpha.
portfolio_role_if_it_works: Cross-asset crash/turbulence warning layer that reduces gross during externally observed systemic stress while abstaining when predictive IC is weak.
rebalance_rule: Crypto name rotation and re-risk on Mondays or liquidity-universe changes; immediate de-risk only when desired gross is at least 15 percentage points below held gross.
research_cadence_note: The repository's 24->6->3 cadence is for fresh independent-alpha discovery. This is a user-directed allocator experiment against a named mechanism, so it is preregistered directly with parent, ablation and directional falsifier rather than marketed as a new independent alpha family.

risk_state.aggregation: component median; confidence = clip(1 - 2 * median absolute component disagreement, 0, 1)
risk_state.ic_health: fast and slow rolling Pearson IC of lagged fresh stock risk_on vs already-realized crypto market return, Fisher-z transformed; health is the minimum of the two positive z-strengths and reaches 1 at z>=2 on both windows

selection_rule: Equal-weighted rank ensemble of residual momentum, path-efficient trend, low downside volatility and positive-return hit rate; select automatic top five positive scores.
thesis: When equity systemic stress rises coherently across volatility term structure, covariance commonality, downside breadth, drawdown, and dispersion, subsequent crypto market returns should deteriorate often enough to justify de-risking, but only while the stock-state/crypto-return information coefficient is currently healthy on both fast and slow windows.
universe_rule: Crypto weights only on contemporaneous is_liquid names with observed positive close; no hard-coded crypto symbols. Stock state uses contemporaneous S&P 500 is_liquid membership.
